[[File:SpiderRoach.jpg|250px|thumb|Spider-roaches]]

'''Spider-roaches''' were arthropods found on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dark Apprentice novel">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref> They lived primarily in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]].<ref name="Shadow Hunter">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> Spider-roaches were also similar in appearance to the many times larger [[Kolosolok]]s.<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>
